item.title: American Dennis Coyle lands in Texas after over a year in Taliban captivity
item.description: Dennis Coyle, a 64-year-old American man held by the Taliban in Afghanistan for more than a year without charges, landed on U.S. soil on Wednesday.

item.title: STEVE FORBES: Drive out wealth, then beg — Hochul’s New York in a nutshell
item.description: New York Gov. Kathy Hochul's appeal to wealthy taxpayers highlights the state's stark contrast with Florida, which has no income tax and faster economic growth.

item.title: SEE IT: Travelers sound off as ICE agents deployed to airports as shutdown drags past 40 days
item.description: Travelers are divided over Trump's plan to deploy ICE agents to airports as the DHS shutdown leaves TSA workers unpaid and increasingly short-staffed.

item.title: Jack Keane warns ceasefire with Iran would 'play right into their hands' as Trump signals deal progress
item.description: Retired Gen. Jack Keane warns against an Iran ceasefire, saying it plays into Tehran's hands and that sustained military pressure is the path to a deal.

item.title: Japanese pro wrestling star Miyu Yamashita gears up for Las Vegas return at Slam Fest
item.description: Tokyo Joshi Pro Wrestling will be among the companies featured at Slam Fest in Las Vegas in the days leading up to WrestleMania 42 next month.

item.title: Air taxis in the U.S. could launch this summer
item.description: A new federal eVTOL program targets passenger, cargo, and medical flights across 26 states, with autonomous air taxi operations potentially on the horizon.

item.title: Stephen Colbert's surprising next act after 'The Late Show' ends: Co-writing a 'Lord of the Rings' film
item.description: Late-night hsot Stephen Colbert will co-write a new Lord of the Rings film after his "Late Show" stint ends in May, he revealed in a video alongside Peter Jackson.

item.title: Kurt Russell says Elvis Presley took surprising precaution before he kicked him during filming
item.description: Kurt Russell recalls kicking Elvis Presley on set at age 12 and later playing him at 27 in a TV movie, calling it his career-turning-point role.

item.title: Texas coach gives fiery, expletive-laden halftime speech before Longhorns' upset over Gonzaga
item.description: Head coach Sean Miller's expletive-laden halftime speech helped spark Texas' 74-68 upset of Gonzaga, earning the Longhorns their first Sweet 16 appearance since 2023.
